craft_notes: Sthāyin: śeṣavṛtti unit 10. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 7. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Those two natural and seedless who would speak for remaining activity; progressively identity means Guru worship devoted but those two.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tau sāṃsiddhikanirbījau ko vadeccheṣavṛttaye kramāttanmayatopāyagurvarcanaratau tu tau
